_about: Replacement level per app league: WAR = WAA + credit(role), in wins at the engine's fixed playing time (hitter: per 600 PA = H31; catcher: hitter x H32/H31 = 500/600; SP: per 800 BF = H33 IP; RP: per 300 BF = H34 IP). Read by engine/war.py through ingest/ratings.py live_replacement(). Kept outside calib/<LG>/ on purpose: the calibration fingerprint hashes calib/<LG>/currency.json and friends, and WAR = WAA + a constant leaves every WAA cache valid. A league with "use" takes another league's credits (a labelled proxy); its own measurement, when there is one, sits beside it under "measured". See docs/PHASE1_AUDIT.md.

BLM.source: market replacement, measured: median of budget identity on BLM 2057 (1.912 / 2.643 / 0.298), delivered-WAR regression (2.059 / 2.362 / 0.313) and the hitter market pin (1.815) (src/lib/leagueCalib.js replacementMarket)

SSB.source: budget identity on OOTP's own war, SSB 2043 (user decision 2026-10-05: SSB's own measurement replaces BLM's proxy 1.91 / 2.5 / 0.31, which sat inside every 95% range)

measured.method: budget identity on OOTP's own war, SSB 2043 (league 155, level 1, split 1, stint 0; 28 clubs x 162 G; SP when GS >= G/2; slots per 600 PA / 800 BF / 300 BF)
measured.control: the same code on BLM 2057 gives 1.912 / 2.643 / 0.298, his route-1 numbers exactly

RG.note: Regular Game is priced on BLM's calibration; no measurement of its own.
